jobs.description: Fleet Management Software Solution & App | Ravin AI Solution Tools Seller Buyer Solutions Solutions Fleet Solutions Remarketing platforms Insurance providers Service Centers Blog Careers Media Leadership Fleet Solutions Remarketing platforms Insurance providers Service Centers Book your Demo Solutions Fleet Management Software How Ravin’s Fleet Management Solution Works Ravin AutoScan™ cameras installed at fleet hubs Ravin Inspect™ mobile app with self-service functionality for renters, fleet drivers or dealers Built-in Ravin DeepDetect™ AI for optimal performance Ravin Eye™ portal for fleet managers to review Benefits of Ravin’s Fleet Management Solution Safe handoffs in minimal time and optimal damage recovery Improved customer return experience with less friction Efficient fleet repair cycles maintenance with full visibility & competitive repair quotes Maximal remarketing and buy-back value with repair/replace suggestions Learn about Ravin AI’s Fleet Management Solutions The Ravin AutoScan™ system is an autonomous, AI-powered fleet management solution that supports operational processes such as vehicle inspection and returns. With automated video analysis, artificial intelligence processing, and advanced imaging technology , Ravin AutoScan™ captures images of the vehicle condition and delivers detailed reports, all at scale - empowering your business to run more profitably, more efficiently, and with reduced risk. What’s Included in Ravin AI’s Fleet Management Solutions Ravin’s fleet management solution provides a full suite of tools to maximize your fleet performance . The solution offers optimal safety with daily handoff reports and accurate vehicle data reporting. Additionally, our fleet management solutions provide efficient fleet repair cycle maintenance with full visibility and competitive repair quotes , maximizing remarketing and buy-back value for your business. With Ravin’s fleet management software, you can : remotely track the condition of your fleet make sure damage is repaired quickly and ensure your vehicles are always safe in good condition Images and video files are captured via the stationary Ravin AutoScan™ camera system or the Ravin Inspect™ app. The app is an easy-to-use guided inspection tool that allows non-professionals (e.g. drivers or porters) to complete a thorough vehicle inspection. Ravin’s fleet management desktop software, provides a full overview of all vehicle inspections in an easily searchable and filterable format. You can see the condition reports from every inspection and can track vehicle condition over your fleet’s operational lifecycle. Our customers love that they can quickly get an overview of their entire vehicle using just one software tool. Users can track the fleet's history including; movement, new damages, and when existing damages were repaired Ravin's state-of-the-art license plate recognition software makes searching for any prior scan a breeze. jobs.title: Service Centers
jobs.description: Auto Service Centre Solutions | Ravin AI Solution Tools Seller Buyer Solutions Solutions Fleet Solutions Remarketing platforms Insurance providers Service Centers Blog Careers Media Leadership Fleet Solutions Remarketing platforms Insurance providers Service Centers Book your Demo Solutions Service Centres How it works Customers or concierge drivers can self-scan using Ravin Inspect™ mobile app or dealers can install Ravin AutoScan™ camera system Benefits Easy, quick inspections provide transparent upsell service opportunities Enable quick trade appraisals and grading Offer remote diagnosis Improve customer service experience and part / labour extensions with transparent high resolution images Learn more about Ravin AI’s inspection solution for Toyota service centers In partnership with Toyota service centers, Ravin has introduced a set of plug-and-play AI tools to assist with visual inspections and communications alongside existing management systems. Ravin's automated solution for Toyota vehicle inspections blends seamlessly into any service center's daily operations. It leverages sets of standard CCTV cameras at the entrance gate, to automatically register the vehicle and its physical condition. No installation of dedicated software or sophisticated hardware is required. Images, and any issues documented on the Ravin tools, can be exported into existing service management systems and used for future reference. Ravin assists in providing more evidence of required repairs, available via text / WhatsApp. The AI helps mechanics to simply show an issue to the camera, and the AI picks the best possible images. This goes automatically into a report that the customer service rep can share with the customer. Benefits for Toyota Service Centres and Their Customers Ravin AI’s vehicle inspection solution for Toyota service centers is a convenient and efficient way to get your service center’s cars inspected and documented. With Ravin Inspect™ mobile app, customers can scan the vehicle themselves at check-in, or a Toyota service provider can do it for them. Once the Toyota vehicle is scanned, Ravin’s automated vehicle inspection solution provides the service center with a full report including high-resolution images of what needs to be fixed . The report also includes an estimate of how much time and money it will take to fix everything on the list. Ravin’s vehicle inspection products make car servicing faster and more transparent . By clearly documenting the condition of the vehicle when it is delivered and returned, Ravin’s AI software brings trust and transparency to the service and maintenance process. And when customers receive multiple crisp images, clearly illustrating the work that needs to be done, they are happy to approve it and are satisfied to see the same images afterward.
